item.tib: o rgyan 'chi med bstan gnyis gling pas skye phreng gsol 'debs skal ldan lam zin
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsal lam 'chi med bstan gnyis gling pa'i skye phreng gsol 'debs skal ldan lam zin zhes bya ba rang mthun gyi grogs bzang re 'gas sngar nas bskul ba dang / khyad par kun grags mchog spral rin po ches bka' nan spyi bor phebs pa la/ mi ldog du mkha' 'gro'i lung cha shas la bsten nas/ rang 'dod tshul chos kyis dben pa 'bol gtam kho shar du/ yi ge rim byed thog mar kun grags pas bgyis tshe/ dge des 'gro kun srid mtshor dbug 'byin shog/
